item.title: Liquor smugglers use code names and clever hiding tricks to evade prohibition in Bihar
item.description: Smugglers in Bihar are becoming increasingly inventive in their methods to transport liquor despite prohibition. They employ coded phrases to substitute recognizable brand names in their communications for secrecy. Various creative concealment techniques are used, such as hiding liquor in snack items, medication containers, and altered vehicles. As they adapt to enforcement efforts, authorities grapple with the challenge of dismantling these elaborate smuggling operations.

item.title: Punjab's poll drug debate has old players in new roles: BJP, Cong attack; AAP defends
item.description: Gulzar Singh's alleged suicide has brought Punjab's drug problem back into the political spotlight ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. AAP now has nearly five years in office to defend, Congress is reviving its old attacks, and the BJP is making the issue a major part of its statewide push.

item.title: US labor dept hints at 'total shutdown' of H-1B visa program
item.description: Anthony D'Esposito, Inspector General at the Department of Labor, announced an investigation into the H-1B visa program. Investigators are focusing on fraud related to foreign labor, which may lead to significant reforms. D'Esposito indicated that the program could look very different in one year. The administration is also examining colleges allegedly exploiting J-1 visas, as part of a wider crackdown.

item.title: 14-year-old Georgia student scores perfect 1600 on SAT
item.description: At just 14 years old, Ashrit Talluri from Georgia has achieved remarkable success, scoring a flawless 1600 on the SAT exam. Having earned 14½ high school credits in middle school, he is now taking college-level courses as a ninth grader at Innovation Academy. With five months of meticulous preparation behind him, Ashrit dreams of becoming a neurosurgeon, eager to delve into projects that combine cutting-edge technology with healthcare.

item.title: How Stephen and Ayesha Curry built an empire while giving back to Oakland
item.description: Stephen and Ayesha Curry have built successful careers beyond basketball and Hollywood while maintaining a strong connection to Oakland. Stephen expanded into media through Unanimous Media, while Ayesha grew Sweet July into a lifestyle brand spanning food, skincare and content. Through Eat. Learn. Play., they have invested more than $100 million in Oakland, supporting meals, literacy, schoolyards and youth programmes, turning their success into long-term community impact.

item.title: Bill Gates Foundation to shut down in 2045: Why some Americans reject its $400m ‘gift’
item.description: The Bill Gates Foundation is making a bold move by committing $1 billion to ensure equitable AI development for education and healthcare. Of this, $400 million is dedicated to creating AI-driven tutoring systems that tailor learning experiences. This investment arrives amidst rising discussions about digital tools' effectiveness and privacy issues, with New York City already enacting a one-year pause on generative AI in schools.

item.title: Katrina says mom left London for Tamil Nadu village to help kids
item.description: In 2008, Suzanne Turquotte relocated from London to Tamil Nadu with a mission to uplift local communities through her initiative, Relief Projects India. Initially providing free evening tuition for children, the organization broadened its scope to address a range of community needs. She also co-founded the Mountain View School, aiming to deliver English-language education to children in farming families.

item.title: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s $2.9B investment: How did it reach 5,000 stores?
item.description: Jason Kelce has made a savvy equity investment in Hank Sauce via Winnie Capital, marking a significant step for both him and the brand. Once a local staple, Hank Sauce now boasts distribution in over 5,000 stores across the country. With a U.S. hot sauce market worth nearly $2.9 billion, this partnership looks to amplify Hank Sauce's visibility and reach nationally, taking advantage of the substantial growth opportunities ahead.

item.title: Travis Kelce’s $12.35M real estate empire: How did he build it?
item.description: Travis Kelce has built an impressive real estate portfolio spanning Kansas and Ohio. His reported properties include a 17,000-square-foot Leawood mansion, a 21,000-square-foot lakefront estate in Bratenahl and a former 10,000-square-foot Kansas City home. Together, the three properties cover nearly 48,000 square feet, with reported purchase prices totalling about $12.35 million. His Leawood home also reportedly served as the setting for his 2025 proposal to Taylor Swift.

item.title: Stock market rout: Sensex sinks to 6-month low, Rs 17 lakh crore wiped out in a month
item.description: The sell-off intensified on Monday. The BSE benchmark plunged 1,124.02 points, or 1.52%, to close at 72,771.72, marking its lowest closing level since March 30, 2026. The Nifty fell 360.25 points, or 1.56%, to finish at 22,780.25, its lowest level in nearly six months. The weakness was also visible beyond the frontline indices. The BSE SmallCap Select index fell 1.90%, while the MidCap Select index declined 1.39%.

item.title: Bigg Boss 20: Uditi Singh calls her breakup with ex Karan Wahi 'a blessing in disguise'
item.description: Uditi Singh has been discussing her past relationship with Karan Wahi and their subsequent breakup. She described the breakup as a blessing in disguise and noted it reshaped her career and personal life. Uditi revealed that their relationship strained after adopting a pet and issues surrounding cleanliness arose. She also mentioned her mother's disapproval of their age gap affecting their dynamic.

item.title: Another child rape case against granite baron Veeramani 12 years after girl’s suicide
item.description: R Veeramani, previously arrested in a child rape case, has been charged with another incident. This new charge relates to the suicide of a 16-year-old girl in 2014, prompting her mother to file a complaint. The case remained dormant due to police record loss after a fire. The special investigation team is now looking into both incidents and collecting evidence from the public.
item.dc:creator: A SELVARAJ

item.title: Gautam Adani, 4 group firms settle with Sebi in minimum public shareholding violation case
item.description: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani and his companies have reached a settlement with Sebi regarding violations of minimum public shareholding laws. They agreed to pay Rs 1.48 crore to close the matter, which stemmed from complaints filed in 2020. Although the involved parties denied any wrongdoing, Sebi will refrain from further enforcement actions unless similar issues come up in the future.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: India realty sees record $9.5bn equity inflow in Q3: Report
item.description: India's real estate landscape experienced an unprecedented surge in equity investment, hitting $9.5 billion in the September 2026 quarter, a staggering increase from last year's $4.4 billion. Data centres accounted for 57 percent of these inflows, illustrating a pivotal change in investment strategy. Furthermore, foreign investors contributed nearly 59 percent, indicating a strong global appetite for Indian real estate.

item.title: Once known for tree-lined avenues, craters define these posh areas in Bhopal now
item.description: BHEL township in Bhopal has experienced severe damage to roads due to recent monsoon rainfall. Residents are now navigating potholes, muddy stretches, and waterlogged patches daily. Commuters have reported increased vehicle breakdowns and accidents related to these conditions. While civic agencies promise repairs, residents find temporary fixes insufficient for long-term relief. There are urgent calls for comprehensive solutions to restore safety and the area's reputation.
item.dc:creator: RAMENDRA SINGH

item.title: 'Leave us alone': 3 students say LPU posted rape 'truth' video without consent
item.description: Three female students from Lovely Professional University stated that a video of them was released without their consent. This video allegedly dismissed claims of a rape incident on campus involving a plumber. Following the allegations, students protested and vandalized property and blocked a highway for over 15 hours.

item.title: Asian Games: Athletics leads India’s 8-medal haul, boxing assures more
item.description: India has made remarkable strides in the Asian Games 2026, gathering a total of eight medals in athletics, shooting, and kurash. Notably, Yashvir Singh and Rohit Yadav achieved a spectacular javelin double, while Murali Sreeshankar secured a silver in the long jump. Contributions from Esha Singh and Pincky Balhara, who earned silver and bronze medals respectively, further bolstered the nation's success.

item.title: Asian Games Medal Tally: India win 8 medals but remain outside top 10
item.description: India won eight medals on Day 9 of the Asian Games, including four silver and four bronze. Notable performances included Yashvir Singh and Rohit Yadav securing silver and bronze in the men's javelin. Esha Singh earned silver in the women's 25m pistol, while several athletes contributed to the medal tally across different sports. Despite the successes, India's gold medal count remained at four, keeping it in 12th place overall.
